description: Event type resource. Defines the payload contract for events published on a topic. Identified by a GTS event-type identifier and bound to a topic.

topic.description: Full GTS topic identifier this event type belongs to.

allowed_subject_types.description: GTS Type-id patterns describing which subject types (a GTS Type id naming the kind of entity) this event type's events may declare (concrete Type match, wildcard suffix `<prefix>.*`, or bare base Type `<base>~` with implicit derived-type coverage). Enforced at publish time as a schema constraint, independent of the subject_type:produce/:consume authorization check.

data_schema.description: JSON Schema for the event payload. v1 treats event types as immutable: any change requires a new event type with a new GTS identifier.
